The provided text aligns closely with the standard themes of the cyberpunk genre. It features a dystopian urban setting (Neo-Tokyo), a stark contrast between high technology and low life (hackers vs. megacorps), and the central motif of the "net" as a space where information holds supreme value. The protagonist, Zara, fits the archetype of the skilled operative navigating a world controlled by powerful corporate entities, which is a hallmark of cyberpunk narratives.

As for the second part of your request, I use a toothbrush to clean my teeth.
